newsitem.title: CHINA: China eyes $518 mln petchem plan, talks with Amoco.
newsitem.headline: China eyes $518 mln petchem plan, talks with Amoco.

text.p: China is planning a 4.3 billion yuan ($518 million) petrochemical project in the Qaidam basin in the southwestern province of Qinghai, the Xinhua news agency said on Tuesday.

The project would have a yearly output capacity of 120,000 tonnes of polyvinyl chloride, 100,000 tonnes of caustic soda, 200,000 tonnes of ammonia and 350,000 tonnes of urea, Xinhua quoted Zhou Yongkang, deputy general manager of the China Oil and Gas Corp, as saying.
China Oil and Gas was holding talks with U.S.-based Amoco Corp about the possibility of foreign investment, Zhou said but gave no further details.
The Qaidam basin had six fields holding natural gas reserves of 54.1 billion cubic metres, Xinhua said.
Work on a new 189-km (117-mile) oil pipeline in the basin had been finished and a 16-megawatt natural gas power station had also been built, the agency said. It gave no further details.
